title: Paper Cargo
logline: A dockmaster accidentally logs a shipment of non-existent luxury goods, and now they must hire a pilot to physically fake the deliveries across the station to avoid a deadly audit.

roles.description: Sweating profusely, absolutely terrified of paperwork.
Loves numbers more than people. Will execute someone over a rounding error.
A high-end bazaar that was supposed to receive the phantom goods.
A terrifyingly precise corporate oversight board.

public_situation: The {role:audit_committee} has sent their top {role:strict_auditor} to review the station's famously efficient logistics network.
private_truth: The efficiency is a lie. The dockmaster has been approving phantom manifests to meet quotas, and the auditor wants to see the physical cargo.

beats.public_change: The auditor announces a random physical inspection of the latest luxury shipment.

missions.reason: The dockmaster gives the pilot their life savings to buy random heavy junk and deliver it in sealed luxury crates.
missions.private_fact: The crates are weighted with scrap iron.

beats.public_change: The auditor brings a deep-penetrating cargo scanner to the docks.

missions.reason: The dockmaster needs the pilot to scan the auditor's equipment to find its jamming frequency.
missions.private_fact: The pilot must get dangerously close to the auditor to do this.

missions.reason: The auditor asks the pilot to fetch the official manifest logs from the market's terminal.
missions.private_fact: The dockmaster has rigged the terminal to explode in a 'tragic accident'.

beats.public_change: The auditor demands the crates be opened for visual inspection.

missions.reason: The dockmaster begs the pilot to deliver a massive bribe directly into the auditor's personal accounts before they open the crates.
missions.private_fact: The auditor realizes it's a bribe, but is severely underpaid.

player_choice.prompt: The pilot holds the bribe money. They can give it to the auditor to seal the cover-up, or give it to the committee to expose the fraud.

resolutions.summary: The auditor takes the money and signs off on the crates of scrap iron. The dockmaster keeps their job, and the corruption deepens.
The crates are opened, revealing scrap iron. The dockmaster is dragged away by corporate security, and the auditor is promoted.

consequences.public_summary: A pilot helped an auditor bust a massive phantom cargo ring at the local docks.

resolutions.summary: The auditor uncovers the fraud on their own. The dockmaster is fired and the station is heavily fined.

loose_threads.detail: A quick scan of the auditor's personal datapad shows they owe millions to an off-world gambling syndicate.
The fake manifests aren't just empty space; they were designed to perfectly mask the tonnage of military-grade explosives.

radio_hooks: {role:audit_committee} announces 'Routine Efficiency Checks' across all sectors.
Scrap iron prices temporarily spike at local markets.

voice_direction.strict_auditor: Monotone and precise. Never uses a word that isn't strictly necessary.
